event.text:
Updated `compose/sketchpad/index.tsx` so drag diff coloring now follows the same palette behavior as the algorithm storybook diagram, while keeping drag behavior intact.

### What changed
- **Piece diff colors** now use the same diff tokens as storybook:
  - added → `var(--color-new, #22c55e)`
  - removed → `var(--color-removed, #ef4444)`
  - modified → `var(--color-modified, #f59e0b)`
- **Piece hover/selection colors** now match storybook interaction logic:
  - default hover/selected → `var(--accent-secondary)` / `var(--accent)`
  - changed hover/selected → `var(--color-changed-hovered)` / `var(--color-changed-selected)`
- **Connection diff colors** updated to the same `new/removed/modified` tokens.
- **Connection hover/selection colors** now also follow default-vs-changed accent mapping, matching algorithm storybook visuals.

### What stayed the same
- Drag functionality and transaction behavior are unchanged.
- Existing edge dash/opacity rules (e.g., added dashed, removed lower opacity) remain in place.
- No linter issues were introduced (`ReadLints` clean for `compose/sketchpad/index.tsx`).

event.text:
Adjusted — this now matches the algorithm storybook highlight behavior for drag diff states across all interaction cases, without changing drag functionality.

### What I changed in `compose/sketchpad/index.tsx`
- Reworked piece highlight logic to use the same interaction matrix as storybook:
  - **default + selected** → `var(--accent)`
  - **default + hovered** → `var(--accent-secondary)`
  - **changed (added/removed/modified) + selected** → `var(--color-changed-selected)`
  - **changed (added/removed/modified) + hovered** → `var(--color-changed-hovered)`
- Kept base diff status colors aligned to storybook:
  - added → `var(--color-new, #22c55e)`
  - removed → `var(--color-removed, #ef4444)`
  - modified → `var(--color-modified, #f59e0b)`
- Connection highlight behavior already follows the same parity now:
  - selected default vs changed uses `accent` vs `color-changed-selected`
  - hovered default vs changed uses `accent-secondary` vs `color-changed-hovered`

### Why this fixes your note
Your previous concern was correct: selected changed entities could still map to selected-added/removed variants instead of the storybook “changed highlight” color. That branch is now removed so drag preview highlighting is consistent for single-piece and multi-piece drag scenarios.

No lint errors were introduced.

event.text:
Implemented a logic fix for diff propagation in `compose/sketchpad/index.tsx` so status updates stay consistent across related kit elements (both connection endpoints), independent of hover/select styling.

### What was wrong
`getTransactionAffectedPieces()` only tracked `pieces.updated/added/removed`.  
So when a change came through `connections.*`, the related pieces on both ends were not reliably marked as changed.

### What I changed
In `getTransactionAffectedPieces()` I added connection-aware propagation:

- Build a `connectionGuid -> {connectedPieceGuid, connectingPieceGuid}` lookup from current design.
- Track connection diffs from transaction edits:
  - `connections.updated` → mark both endpoint pieces as `Modified`
  - `connections.added` → mark both endpoint pieces as `Added`
  - `connections.removed` → mark both endpoint pieces as `Removed`
- For removals that only contain a connection GUID, recover endpoints from inverse (`undo`) data when available.
- Kept existing piece-diff tracking behavior and precedence rules intact.

### Result
When a kit element is added/removed/modified in Sketchpad through connection-driven edits, the corresponding related elements on both ends are now updated consistently in the diff state pipeline.

I did not alter hover/select interaction styling in this change.
